name: laplacelib
comment: The library dialect shares every pattern with `source.laplace` -- same expressions, `library { }` block, `pkg::func` calls, comments, literals and types, and since patch 1 also `pub`, `func(...) -> ...` parameter types, `@wait(...)`, and `@template` / `@macro` definitions. It differs only in what it does not require: a `.laplacelib` file may be bare function definitions with no `functions { }` wrapper and no model-shaped blocks at all. None of the shared patterns are scoped to an enclosing block, so nothing has to be relaxed here -- which is also why the `parameters { }` / `model { }` blocks inside a `@template` body highlight here exactly as they do in a `.laplace` file, with no library-specific pattern for them. The separate scope name exists so themes and future semantic-token work can target the two dialects independently.
